claims.quote: a mouse model of NEO-DEE carrying the p.(Thr274Met) variant of Kcnq2

claims.object_text: intractable seizures accompanied by an abnormal neurodevelopment
claims.quote: intractable seizures accompanied by an abnormal neurodevelopment

claims.object_text: ultrasound-induced seizures (UIS) protocol in Kcnq2p.(Thr274Met/+) mouse model
claims.quote: We developed a protocol to trigger ultrasound-induced seizures (UIS) on demand in this model.

claims.object_text: UIS have the same phenotypic expression and severity as spontaneous generalized seizures
claims.quote: We show that the UIS have the same phenotypic expression and the same severity as spontaneous generalized seizures (SGS) in the Kcnq2-NEO-DEE mouse model.

claims.object_text: activation of 6 brain regions 2 h after seizure induction
claims.quote: C-fos labeling reveals a subset of 6 brain regions activated 2 h after the induction of the seizure.

claims.object_text: developmental period of susceptibility to ultrasound
claims.quote: The developmental period during which mice exhibit SGS corresponds to the period during which Kcnq2p.(Thr274Met/+) mice are the most susceptible to US.
